appFeatures.title: Power on / off
appFeatures.text: Switch the scooter on or off from your phone.

appFeatures.title: Arm / disarm
appFeatures.text: Lock and unlock security from the app.

appFeatures.title: Proximity unlock
appFeatures.text: Walk up with your phone and the scooter unlocks. No key needed.

appFeatures.title: Open seat from app
appFeatures.text: Unlock the seat with a tap.

appFeatures.title: Find my scooter
appFeatures.text: Make it sound so you can spot it in a crowded parking lot.

appFeatures.title: NFC key management
appFeatures.text: Add or remove NFC keys and smart cards.

appFeatures.title: Startup password
appFeatures.text: A PIN before the scooter will start.

appFeatures.title: Live battery voltage
appFeatures.text: See the real battery voltage in the app, e.g. 66.0V.

appFeatures.title: Music via Bluetooth
appFeatures.text: Pair your phone with the instrument cluster for music.

appFeatures.title: Handlebar music controls
appFeatures.text: Previous, next, volume and play/pause from the handlebar buttons.

appFeatures.title: Incoming call alert
appFeatures.text: The last 4 digits of the caller show on the dashboard.

appFeatures.title: Dashboard customisation
appFeatures.text: Choose what the meter shows, such as trip or battery voltage.

appFeatures.title: Function buttons
appFeatures.text: Set single-click, double-click and long-press actions.

appFeatures.title: Lighting settings
appFeatures.text: Adjust the scooter's lighting from the app.

appFeatures.title: Sound effects
appFeatures.text: Pick the sounds the scooter makes.
